description: This file implements database operations for managing notification hints in the focalboard project, including creating, updating, deleting, and fetching notification hints from the database.

methods.name: valuesForNotificationHint
methods.description: Converts a NotificationHint object into a slice of interface{} for database insertion.

methods.name: notificationHintFromRows
methods.description: Reads multiple NotificationHint objects from SQL rows.

methods.name: upsertNotificationHint
methods.description: Creates or updates a notification hint in the database, setting notify_at based on current time plus notifyFreq.

methods.name: deleteNotificationHint
methods.description: Deletes a notification hint for a specific block ID.

methods.name: getNotificationHint
methods.description: Fetches a notification hint for a specific block ID.

methods.name: getNextNotificationHint
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled notification hint, optionally removing it from the database.
